name: OI-flush capitulation V-bounce (15m long, ATR-scaled stop)
rationale: MECHANISM (H1 with a volatility-scaled stop): identical forced-deleveraging exhaustion, but because a flush prints in the violent-vol regime a FIXED percent stop is either too tight (whipsawed out of the very V it is trying to catch) or too loose. This variant sizes the initial stop as an ATR-multiple at the entry bar, so protection scales with the cascade's realized volatility — the honest way to hold through the knife-edge of the bounce. Counterparty and edge unchanged from H1 (price-insensitive liquidation flow, self-terminating flush). Entry: open_interest cross_down through a fitted floor AND ret_Nd below a negative floor AND rsi below an oversold floor AND vol_realized above a floor. DISCONFIRMER: remove open_interest — if oversold+falling matches, OI is redundant; flip ret_Nd to UP — profit means the sign is noise. The ATR stop must not merely widen the loser tail: net of ~20bps the V must still clear.
catalyst: 15m OI flush + oversold + falling, held on an ATR-scaled stop through the bounce
